title: Enterprise Connectivity: resource disposal
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs resource disposal for application withdrawal, active-service termination, suspended-service termination.

## Policy clause 1
The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

## Policy clause 2
Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources.

## Policy clause 3
An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge.

## Policy clause 4
For active or suspended contracts, record closure date from the fixed current handling time and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time.

## Policy clause 5
Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits. on-demand termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under lifecycle fee rules.

## Policy clause 6
If a signed commitment remains unexpired and commitment forgiveness permission is false, invoice its recorded recorded remaining commitment liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability.

## Policy clause 7
No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible.

## Policy clause 8
Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect.

## Policy clause 9
Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies recorded remaining commitment liability in USD and is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains.

## Policy clause 10
A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its source-event reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

## Evidence condition 1
For application withdrawal, active-service termination, suspended-service termination, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. The evidence consists of contract identifier, request reference, source-event reference. Correlate the same contract identifier, request reference, source-event reference to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Points of judgement
A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its source-event reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the on-demand termination fee, commitment forgiveness permission used by this rule.

## Record identity: application withdrawal
The user moves the contract from applied to closed. One persistent contract per signed resource scope.

## Record identity: active-service termination
The user moves the contract from active to closed. One persistent contract per signed resource scope.

## Record identity: suspended-service termination
The user moves the contract from suspended to closed. One persistent contract per signed resource scope.
